rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: The available central office bearers, meeting at the Central Office at 3.00 p.m. on 14 March 2001 with Vice-president Shri K. Jana Krishnamurthi presiding, 'considered the letter from Shri Bangaru Laxman addressed to Shri K. Jana Krishnamurthi, Vice President offering to step down from the office of the president of the party pending enquiry'.

locator.section: Press Release March 14, 2001, first and second paragraphs

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: The same meeting of the office bearers on 14 March 2001, having considered Shri Bangaru Laxman's letter, 'unanimously decided to accept the resignation with immediate effect' (release signed by Dr. Ram Kripal Sinha, Office Secretary).

locator.section: sentence 'The meeting unanimously decided to accept the resignation with immediate effect.'

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: The same meeting 'also decided that Shri K. Jana Krishnamurthi, Vice President will be the acting president to head the party'.
